title: Lift the swift-algorand cap below 0.4.0 by moving to swift-algokit 0.1.0, which builds against swift-algorand 0.4
description: Lift the swift-algorand cap below 0.4.0 by moving to swift-algokit 0.1.0, which builds against swift-algorand 0.4
no_spec_change_rationale: AlgoChat's public API is unchanged: its initializers already throw, and only dependency bounds and internal try expressions change.
acceptance_criteria: swift-algochat resolves and builds against swift-algorand 0.4 through swift-algokit 0.1.0; the non-localnet test suite passes; AlgoChat's public API is unchanged.
